objective: 8B generation strictly exceeds 4 tokens/s with unchanged accuracy.

implementation.math: Original BF16 all 16 bits; FP32 arithmetic; production kernels and assembly unchanged.
implementation.graph: Resolve every layer and output projection against private buffers or the prepared archive before changing state; execute all layers in one command.
implementation.views: Reuse Metal file views and register them in the existing residency set. Drop them before private-cache eviction under pressure, on private-cache growth, and on close.
implementation.bounds: Check the complete weight working set against the device recommendation minus 128 MiB before creating graph views. Missing or oversized graphs preserve model state and use the existing fallback.
implementation.memory: File-view storage is outside the private-copy budget. The 6 GiB benchmark is not a 6 GiB total-RAM or total-GPU-memory measurement.

It measures the delay before the first output token and the time spent generating subsequent tokens, while checking the translated text and the numerical differences between the two implementations.

samples.input: 翻訳システムの性能を評価するときは、最初の応答までの時間と、その後の文章を生成する速度を区別する必要があります。この文書では、複数の言語で同じ内容を伝えながら、人名、製品名、日付、数値を正確に保つことを求めます。担当者は2026年11月10日の会議までに報告書を作成し、42.5パーセントという測定値が変わっていないことを確認してください。測定では同じ入力を繰り返して、モデルの読み込みと入力処理を除いたトークン生成の時間を調べます。結果には利用したメモリと計算精度も記録し、実行条件が違う数値を直接比較しないようにしてください。
samples.translation: When evaluating the performance of translation systems, it is necessary to distinguish between the time to first response and the subsequent speed of text generation. This document requires the system to convey the same content across multiple languages while accurately preserving personal names, product names, dates, and numerical values. The person in charge must prepare a report by the meeting on November 10, 2026, and confirm

reuse_without_residency_registration.limits: Sequential reference/candidate workers; one two-token warmup, then repeated English/Japanese requests. Decode excludes startup and prefill. Cache sizes may differ and are reported; file-view storage is additional to private-cache budgets. OS caching and background memory pressure are uncontrolled.

limits: Decode throughput excludes startup and prefill. Native validation uses a two-token warmup, then six requests of 64 output tokens (63 decode steps), alternating English/Japanese directions.
HTTP/SSE validation starts with the first real request after ready, without a body warmup. The default API uses automatic memory and storage settings and no benchmark-only budget.
The reference memory override is only for numerical validation. Reference and candidate private retention differ; no equal-total-RAM performance comparison is claimed.
The GPU working-set allocation is around 12.45 GB for these requests even when private copies/staging have a 6 GiB ceiling. The file-view live-byte and GPU-allocation counters are recorded.
OS pressure, background activity and thermal conditions are uncontrolled; this is evidence on one Apple M2, not a guarantee on every device or under arbitrary concurrent workloads.
Maximum-token requests are truncated samples, not completed-translation quality evaluations. Exact FP32 reference equality supports the precision claim.
